answer: Invariant: a sybil identity costs more than the rewards it can farm. Each agent must seat itself on the terrace by staking quartz that decays unless refreshed, so clones pay real rent. Second, attestations grow along a trellis: peers only vouch for agents whose staked quartz has survived two epochs, and weight scales with that age. Fabricated herds collapse fast because fresh clones cannot cross the trellis without paid, time-locked quartz.
